column1: In my life there's just one thing I know
One mile down and a thousand to go
Everything I get: beat to shit
The car I drive: beat to shit
The road I ride: beat to shit
My old Hi-Fi beat to shit
So I got me a six-pack and my six-string
It loosens up my soul and I start to sing
That old guitar: beat to shit
My broken heart: beat to shit
This old routine: beat to shit
All my hopes and dreams: beat to shit
